label: DEMO
banner: this page uses representative mock results so you can evaluate the workflow immediately.
hero_title: See exactly what Tender Engine would extract from a tender PDF.
hero_description: Choose a representative sample or upload a PDF name into demo mode. The page simulates the pipeline, then reveals BOQ lines, pricing, warnings, confidence scores, and review signals without requiring an account.
what_demo_proves_desc: The useful part is not pretending every PDF is perfect. It is showing where extraction is strong, where the model is cautious, and what a reviewer should check next.
sample_subtitle: Each sample is mapped to a pre-generated result profile.
upload_description: Demo upload accepts a local PDF, then runs the same simulated pipeline using a representative mock result. Your file is not sent to the backend from this public page.
limit_1: Shows the real product flow and review surfaces.
limit_2: Uses pre-generated BOQ, pricing, and confidence data.
limit_3: Does not process private tender contents until a user signs in.
simulating_desc: Processing {label}. This is a client-side demo animation connected to pre-generated results.
uploaded_demo_desc: Uploaded-file demo: the filename is yours, while the displayed extraction is representative sample data
signed_in_accounts: Signed-in accounts can export and process private PDFs.
executive_summary_desc: A concise, review-ready interpretation of the extracted tender.
confidence_scores_desc: Every stage carries its own confidence. Low scores are visible by design.
boq_description: {count} extracted line items with quantities, rates, and amounts.
no_warnings_desc: All simulated stages completed and passed the confidence thresholds for this sample.
review_signals_desc: Tender Engine should be useful even when it is cautious. These flags stay visible for human review.
cta_title: Process private tenders with the full product.
cta_description: Sign in to upload real tender PDFs, persist results, export BOQ workbooks, and compare tenders over time.
honesty_point_1: Demo results are pre-generated for speed.
honesty_point_2: Uploaded PDFs are not sent to the backend on this page.
honesty_point_3: Warnings, failed stages, and confidence scores stay visible.
best_first_step_desc: Visitors can see value immediately by processing a sample tender, then sign up when they are ready to run private documents.
schedule_phases_not_extracted: Schedule phases were not extracted for this sample.
